svg.text: 17b Analytics: food cost, and usage and waste
Route: /admin/analytics · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Two reports for the palengke cycle over a period of days (default the last 14, one market cycle): GET /api/reports/food-cost and /api/reports/usage. Food cost from recipes uses each
sale's cost saved when it was paid; from market purchases, what was actually spent. A purchase figure well above the recipe one points to waste, over-portioning or stock not yet used.
• Market trip rows (puhunan vs benta): each trip plus its top-ups until the next trip, against the sales in the same days. Usage and waste: used by sales, the average per day, wasted
(damaged, spoiled, dropped, over-prepped, with its value at today's cost), bought, and on hand.
